## Try It Out!
### Generate and send PDF invoice after Sharetribe transaction

Automatically generate a PDF invoice and email it to the buyer when a transaction payment is confirmed. Uses a Code node to build the invoice HTML and an HTML-to-PDF API service to convert it.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/transitioned` events.
* An IF node filters for the `transition/confirm-payment` transition.
* A Code node generates invoice HTML with transaction details, line items, tax calculations, and formatted totals.
* An HTTP Request node converts the HTML to a PDF using an external API.
* Gmail sends the invoice PDF to the buyer as an email attachment.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Gmail account.
3. Sign up for an HTML-to-PDF service (e.g., html2pdf.app, APITemplate.io, or CustomJS) and add your API key.
4. Update the HTTP Request node URL and authentication for your chosen PDF service.
5. Customize the invoice HTML in the Code node with your business details.
6. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Gmail account
* HTML-to-PDF API service account

### How to customize
* Add Sharetribe Get User / Get Listing nodes for complete buyer and item details.
* Update the invoice template with your business address, logo, and tax rates.
* Store invoices in Google Drive for record-keeping.
* Add invoice numbering using a counter in Google Sheets.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for transitions
Polls for `transaction/transitioned` events with the full resource for transaction details.

## 2. Filter for payment
Only generates invoices for confirmed payments.

## 3. Generate invoice HTML
Builds a professional invoice template with transaction data. Customize with your business details.

## 4. Convert to PDF & email
Converts the HTML to a PDF file via an external API, then emails it as an attachment.
